limitations.export_shape: Markdown instructions plus machine-readable package manifest.
limitations.action_tool_availability: No packaged tool or action is required; the generic CLI handoff remains user-run outside ChatGPT.
limitations.local_file_handoff: ChatGPT cannot directly write the local decision-log package; the user must create the files and run the generic m3 ingest command.
limitations.marketplace_publication: Not packaged for marketplace publication in this slice; distribute as project/custom instructions.
